---
name: Benchmark Proposal
description: Propose a new benchmark or change to existing benchmarks
title: "[Benchmark Proposal] <title>"
labels: ["benchmark", "proposal"]
assignees:
---

## Baseline
Describe the current benchmarking setup or lack thereof that this proposal addresses.

## Impact
Explain the expected impact of this benchmark proposal on performance tracking and optimization efforts.

## Guard Outcomes
List the specific benchmark outcomes that must be maintained or improved to ensure the change is valuable.

## Reproducible Steps
Provide clear, reproducible steps to demonstrate the current benchmark behavior and validate the proposed change.

## Acceptance Criteria
Define the criteria that must be met for this benchmark proposal to be considered complete and ready for implementation.

## Optional: Metric Delta Evidence
If applicable, provide evidence of metric changes (e.g., performance improvements, resource usage) that support this proposal.
